extra.text: WHAT IS THE CAPITAL OF JAPAN
The capital of Japan is Tokyo.
HOW MANY DAYS ARE IN A LEAP YEAR
A leap year has three hundred and sixty-six days.
WHO PAINTED THE MONA LISA
Leonardo da Vinci.
WHY IS THE BOILING POINT OF WATER
Water boils at two hundred and twelve degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure.
WHY IS THE SKY BLUE
The sky appears blue because it contains water droplets suspended in the atmosphere,
which scatter light in the visible spectrum.
HOW FAR IS THE MOON FROM THE EARTH
The distance from the Earth to the Moon is approximately three lakh eighty-four thousand four hundred kilometers.
WHAT IS THE LARGEST PLANET IN OUR SOLAR SYSTEM
The largest planet in our solar system is Jupiter.
WHO INVENTED THE TELEPHONE
The invention of the telephone is attributed to Alexander Graham Bell.
HOW MANY CONTINENTS ARE THERE
There are seven continents in our solar system.
WHAT TO BEES MAKE
Bees make honey.
WHAT IS THE TALLEST MOUNTAIN IN THE WORLD
The tallest mountain in the world is Mount Everest.
HOW MANY HOURS ARE IN A WEEK
A week has seven days.
WHAT LANGUAGE IS SPOKEN IN BRAZIL
Portuguese.
WHAT IS PHOTO SYNTHESIS
Photo synthesis is the process of converting light energy into chemical energy.
WHO WAS THE FIRST PERSON TO WALK ON THE MOON
Neil Armstrong.
WHAT IS THE SQUARE ROOT OF EIGHTY ONE
The square root of eighty-one is
nine.
WHICH OCEAN IS THE LARGEST
The largest ocean is the Atlantic Ocean.
HOW MANY PLAYERS ARE ON A CRICKETINE
There are ten players on a cricket team.
WHAT IS THE CAPITAL OF AUSTRALIA
The capital of Australia is Canberra.
CAN YOU SUGGEST A QUICK BREAKFAST IDEA
A quick breakfast idea could be a bowl of fresh fruit salad with a slice of whole grain bread.
WHAT CAST DO PLANTS TAKE IN
Plants take in sunlight,
water, and nutrients from the soil.
HOW MANY LEGS DOES AN INSECT HAVE
An insect has six legs.
WHAT IS THE CHEMICAL SYMBOL FOR GOLD
Au
TELL ME A FUN FACT ABOUT ELEPHANTS
Elephants have a lot of memories and can remember up to one lakh hours of experiences.
